```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(R.matlab)
library(gtools)
```

```{r import sniff files}
dir_path <- "D:\\Task sniff params"

# get a list of all .mat files in the directory
file_list <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "\\.mat$", full.names = TRUE)

# read each .mat file and convert to a data frame
sniff_params <- lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  mat_data <- readMat(file)
  as.data.frame(mat_data[[1]])
})
names(sniff_params) <- basename(file_list)

# name sniff columns
sniff_col_names <- c("inhale_ms", "inhale_amp", "exhale_ms", "exhale_amp")
for (i in seq_along(sniff_params)) {
  colnames(sniff_params[[i]]) <- sniff_col_names
}

# extract mouse id and session number from a sniff_params file name
extract_id_session <- function(name) {
  id <- str_extract(name, "\\d{4}")
  session <- str_extract(name, "(?<=_)\\d+(?=\\.mat)")
  list(id = id, session = session)
}
```

```{r trial timing lookup}
# ids/sessions to keep, in "<mouse_id> = c(doi_session, saline_session)" form
keep_ids_sessions <- list(
  `2174` = c(57, 56), `2181` = c(42, 41), `2182` = c(32, 31), `2183` = c(34, 33),
  `2185` = c(41, 40), `2191` = c(25, 21), `2195` = c(17, 20), `2196` = c(18, 16),
  `2197` = c(17, 19), `2198` = c(17, 19), `2200` = c(14, 19), `2201` = c(16, 21),
  `2202` = c(19, 14), `2203` = c(13, 18), `2204` = c(17, 22), `2205` = c(12, 16),
  `2208` = c(18, 14), `2209` = c(14, 18), `2210` = c(17, 13), `2211` = c(13, 17),
  `2212` = c(16, 13), `2213` = c(14, 18)
)

is_matching_file <- function(path) {
  parts <- strsplit(path, "/")[[1]]
  id <- parts[3]
  session <- as.numeric(parts[5])
  id %in% names(keep_ids_sessions) && session %in% keep_ids_sessions[[id]]
}

# trial-level data (tstart/tend/odor_setting), used below to label each
# sniff as within-trial (odor/omission) or between-trial (iti)
trial_summ <- list.files(path = "D:/newmove",
                         recursive = TRUE,
                         pattern = "trialsummary.txt",
                         full.names = TRUE)
trial_summ_iti <- trial_summ[grep("100-0", trial_summ)]
trial_summ_filtered <- Filter(is_matching_file, trial_summ_iti)
trial_summ_sorted <- mixedsort(trial_summ_filtered)

all_data <- lapply(trial_summ_sorted, read.table, header = FALSE, sep = ",")
names(all_data) <- trial_summ_sorted

trial_col_names <- c("trial", "odor_setting", "odor_side", "success", "tstart", "tend", "set_iti")
for (i in seq_along(all_data)) {
  colnames(all_data[[i]]) <- trial_col_names
}

all_data <- lapply(all_data, function(df) {
  transform(df, trial_length = tend - tstart, iti_length = tstart - dplyr::lag(tend))
})

shift <- function(x, n) c(x[-(seq(n))], rep(NA, n))
for (i in seq_along(all_data)) {
  all_data[[i]]$iti_length <- shift(all_data[[i]]$iti_length, 1)
}
```

```{r label sniffs by trial period}
for (sniff_name in names(sniff_params)) {
  sniff_info <- extract_id_session(sniff_name)
  all_data_name <- paste0("D:/newmove/", sniff_info$id, "/100-0/", sniff_info$session, "/trialsummary.txt")
  if (!all_data_name %in% names(all_data)) next

  sniff_df <- sniff_params[[sniff_name]]
  all_data_df <- all_data[[all_data_name]]

  sniff_df <- sniff_df %>%
    mutate(inhale_sec = inhale_ms / 1000, exhale_sec = exhale_ms / 1000)

  # within_trial: does this sniff's inhale fall inside any trial's tstart-tend window?
  sniff_df <- sniff_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(within_trial = any(inhale_sec >= all_data_df$tstart & inhale_sec <= all_data_df$tend)) %>%
    mutate(within_trial = ifelse(within_trial, "Within trial", "Between trials")) %>%
    ungroup()

  # trial_type: for within-trial sniffs, was it an odor (0) or omission (3) trial?
  sniff_df <- sniff_df %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type = case_when(
        within_trial == "Within trial" ~ {
          matched_trial <- findInterval(inhale_sec, all_data_df$tstart, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
          ifelse(
            matched_trial > 0 & matched_trial <= nrow(all_data_df),
            ifelse(all_data_df$odor_setting[matched_trial] == 0, "Odor", "Omission"),
            NA_character_
          )
        },
        within_trial == "Between trials" ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  sniff_params[[sniff_name]] <- sniff_df
}
```

```{r split doi and saline}
doi_conditions <- c(
  "2174_57", "2181_42", "2182_32", "2183_34", "2185_41",
  "2191_25", "2195_17", "2196_18", "2197_17", "2198_17",
  "2200_14", "2201_16", "2202_19", "2203_13", "2204_17",
  "2205_12", "2208_18", "2209_14", "2210_17", "2211_13",
  "2212_16", "2213_14"
)

sniff_params_doi <- list()
sniff_params_saline <- list()

for (df_name in names(sniff_params)) {
  df <- sniff_params[[df_name]]
  mouse_id <- str_extract(df_name, "(?<=sniff_params_sniff_)\\d{4}")
  session_num <- str_extract(df_name, "(?<=_\\d{4}_)\\d+")
  identifier <- paste(mouse_id, session_num, sep = "_")

  if (identifier %in% doi_conditions) {
    sniff_params_doi[[df_name]] <- df
  } else {
    sniff_params_saline[[df_name]] <- df
  }
}

# rename to "<mouse_id>_<session>"
names(sniff_params_doi) <- sapply(names(sniff_params_doi), function(name) {
  sub("sniff_params_sniff_(\\d+_\\d+).mat", "\\1", name)
})
names(sniff_params_saline) <- sapply(names(sniff_params_saline), function(name) {
  sub("sniff_params_sniff_(\\d+_\\d+).mat", "\\1", name)
})
```

```{r compute sniff frequency}
# sniff frequency (hz) = 1000 / time between consecutive inhalations (ms).
# exhale_ms == 0 rows are dropped first (bad/incomplete sniff detections).
compute_frequency <- function(sniff_list) {
  freq_list <- lapply(sniff_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[df$exhale_ms != 0, ]
    df <- df[order(df$inhale_ms), ]
    df$diffs <- c(NA, diff(df$inhale_ms))
    df <- df[df$diffs > 0, ]
    df$frequency <- 1000 / df$diffs
    df
  })
  names(freq_list) <- names(sniff_list)
  freq_list
}

frequency_list_doi <- compute_frequency(sniff_params_doi)
frequency_list_saline <- compute_frequency(sniff_params_saline)

# remove faulty mice from analysis: in doi 2198_17 & 2195_17, in saline
# 2198_19 & 2213_18 - excluded everywhere, including 4a/4b
frequency_list_doi <- frequency_list_doi[!names(frequency_list_doi) %in% c("2198_17", "2195_17")]
frequency_list_saline <- frequency_list_saline[!names(frequency_list_saline) %in% c("2198_19", "2213_18")]

combined_doi_data <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(frequency_list_doi), function(name) {
    data.frame(frequency = frequency_list_doi[[name]]$frequency, mouse_id = name)
  })
)
combined_saline_data <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(frequency_list_saline), function(name) {
    data.frame(frequency = frequency_list_saline[[name]]$frequency, mouse_id = name)
  })
)
```

# Figure 3/4 supplemental - per-mouse Kolmogorov-Smirnov test

```{r matched data}
# pairs each mouse's doi and saline sniff-frequency data, for mice with
# both a usable doi and saline session
generate_matched_frequencies <- function(doi_list, saline_list) {
  ids_doi <- sub("_.*", "", names(doi_list))
  ids_saline <- sub("_.*", "", names(saline_list))
  common_ids <- intersect(ids_doi, ids_saline)

  combined_data <- data.frame()
  for (id in common_ids) {
    doi_name <- names(doi_list)[grepl(paste0("^", id, "_"), names(doi_list))]
    saline_name <- names(saline_list)[grepl(paste0("^", id, "_"), names(saline_list))]

    if (length(doi_name) > 0 && length(saline_name) > 0) {
      doi_df <- doi_list[[doi_name]] %>% mutate(condition = "DOI")
      saline_df <- saline_list[[saline_name]] %>% mutate(condition = "Saline")
      matched_df <- bind_rows(doi_df, saline_df) %>% mutate(mouse_id = id)
      combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data, matched_df)
    }
  }
  combined_data
}

matched_data <- generate_matched_frequencies(frequency_list_doi, frequency_list_saline)
matched_data$condition <- factor(matched_data$condition)
```

```{r ks test per mouse}
# kolmogorov-smirnov test, doi vs. saline sniff frequency, one-tailed
# ("less": doi cdf shifted below saline's, i.e. doi frequencies are higher)
ks_results <- lapply(unique(matched_data$mouse_id), function(mouse) {
  doi_data <- subset(matched_data, mouse_id == mouse & condition == "DOI")$frequency
  saline_data <- subset(matched_data, mouse_id == mouse & condition == "Saline")$frequency
  ks_test <- ks.test(doi_data, saline_data, alternative = "less")
  data.frame(mouse_id = mouse, p_value = ks_test$p.value, statistic = ks_test$statistic)
})
ks_results <- do.call(rbind, ks_results)
ks_results$significant <- ifelse(ks_results$p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
print(ks_results)
```

# Figure 4C - combined sniff frequency distribution

```{r combine frequency lists for pooled stats}
# combine all doi and all saline sniffs (not just matched mice) into one
# data frame, for the pooled fisher-pitman tests and 4c/4d/4e below
frequency_list_doi <- map(frequency_list_doi, ~ mutate(.x, condition = "DOI"))
frequency_list_saline <- map(frequency_list_saline, ~ mutate(.x, condition = "Saline"))

combined_frequency_data <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(frequency_list_doi, ~ .x, .id = "mouse_session"),
  map_dfr(frequency_list_saline, ~ .x, .id = "mouse_session")
)
combined_frequency_data$condition <- factor(combined_frequency_data$condition)
```

```{r fig 4c}
# per-mouse density curves averaged into a mean +/- sem trace
density_df <- combined_frequency_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(frequency)) %>%
  group_by(mouse_session, condition) %>%
  summarize(dens = list(density(frequency, from = 0, to = 16, n = 512)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(x = map(dens, "x"), y = map(dens, "y")) %>%
  unnest(c(x, y))

summary_density <- density_df %>%
  group_by(condition, x) %>%
  summarize(mean_y = mean(y), sem_y = sd(y) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(summary_density, aes(x = x, y = mean_y, color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_y - sem_y, ymax = mean_y + sem_y), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DOI" = "#a449e2", "Saline" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DOI" = "#a449e2", "Saline" = "black")) +
  labs(title = "Sniff frequencies", x = "Sniff frequency (Hz)", y = "Density",
       color = "Condition", fill = "Condition") +
  xlim(0, 16) +
  ylim(0, 0.17) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.9),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2))
```

```{r fig 4a-c stats}
# headline stat for figures 4a-4c: pooled sniff frequency, doi vs. saline,
# fisher-pitman permutation test (coin::oneway_test)
perm_test_result <- oneway_test(
  frequency ~ condition,
  data = combined_frequency_data,
  distribution = approximate(nresample = 10000)
)
print(perm_test_result)
```

```{r fig 4d stats}
# fisher-pitman permutation test, doi vs. saline sniff frequency, for
# each trial type separately
filtered_data_odor_perm <- combined_frequency_data %>% filter(trial_type == "Odor")
perm_test_result_odor <- oneway_test(
  frequency ~ condition, data = filtered_data_odor_perm,
  distribution = approximate(nresample = 10000)
)
print(perm_test_result_odor)

filtered_data_omission_perm <- combined_frequency_data %>% filter(trial_type == "Omission")
perm_test_result_omission <- oneway_test(
  frequency ~ condition, data = filtered_data_omission_perm,
  distribution = approximate(nresample = 10000)
)
print(perm_test_result_omission)

filtered_data_iti_perm <- combined_frequency_data %>% filter(within_trial == "Between trials")
perm_test_result_iti <- oneway_test(
  frequency ~ condition, data = filtered_data_iti_perm,
  distribution = approximate(nresample = 10000)
)
print(perm_test_result_iti)
```

# Figure 4E - median sniff frequency per mouse

```{r fig 4e}
median_freq <- combined_frequency_data %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = sub("_.*", "", mouse_session)) %>%
  group_by(mouse_id, condition) %>%
  summarise(median_frequency = median(frequency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = median_frequency, names_prefix = "median_freq_")

median_freq$sex <- ifelse(median_freq$mouse_id %in% c(2174, 2181, 2191, 2200, 2201, 2202, 2203, 2204, 2210, 2211, 2212, 2213), "F", "M")

group_stats_by_sex <- median_freq %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarize(
    doi_median = median(median_freq_DOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_median = median(median_freq_Saline, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
median_freq %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = median_freq_Saline, y = median_freq_DOI, color = sex, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +

  # add group medians
  geom_point(data = group_stats_by_sex,
             aes(x = saline_median, y = doi_median, color = sex),
             size = 10, shape = 1, stroke = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "#00B19E", "F" = "#990068"), guide = "none") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Median sniff frequency", x = "Saline (Hz)", y = "DOI (Hz)", shape = "Sex") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(5.8, 9.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(5.8, 9.2)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.15),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2)) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c("#990068", "#00B19E"))))
```

```{r fig 4e stats}
result_wilcox_test_medians <- wilcox.test(median_freq$median_freq_DOI,
                                          median_freq$median_freq_Saline,
                                          paired = TRUE)
print(result_wilcox_test_medians)
```
